Proof in the paper: The XRD pattern following the CO2-TPO (Fig. 1A) showed the decomposition of the trimetallic alloy phase to Fe3O4 and Ni-Pd alloy. The DFT calculations indicate that the segregation behavior of Fe is a strong function of the adsorbate layer present, and the presence of Pd in a Fe–Ni alloy reduces the tendency of Fe to segregate to the surface for coverages that are relevant to DRM conditions (see Table 2 in the Discussion section)
